purpose: Cheap, strategy-independent discovery screen across economically distinct long-only A-share families, followed by executable translation only for families that pass fixed promotion gates.

research_window.decision_schedule: Every fifth CY-006 market session after the first 120 sessions; completed 15:00 close only.
research_window.entry_clock: immediately following market session open; skip when that open is not executable

population.security_scope: All .SH/.SZ securities present in exact CY-006 history; no current-survivor list.
eligibility: hard_valid and all required component validity flags
available_at <= decision_at on the completed signal session
trade_status=1 and current_day_data_tradable=true on signal session
no blocking corporate action and rights_ratio=0
population.cross_sectional_selection: Top 20 signal scores per decision date; bottom 20 retained as diagnostic where the score has full cross-sectional support.
population.matched_control: Twenty deterministic hash-ranked eligible securities on each decision date.

coordinate_contract.price_basis: raw unadjusted CY-006 OHLC mapped through the existing causal corporate-action coordinate
coordinate_contract.action_requirements: action known by trade_date, rights_ratio=0, positive multiplier and adjusted prior close; otherwise fail closed
coordinate_contract.signal_features: use only rows through the signal close
coordinate_contract.screen_response: next-session executable open to h5/h20 completed-session close, with visible cash/share actions and fixed round-trip costs
coordinate_contract.executable_exit: time exit decided after the natural holding-session close and filled at the following first sell-executable open

momentum_60.score: causal action-coordinate log return over 60 sessions

short_reversal_5.score: negative causal action-coordinate log return over 5 sessions

breakout_60.score: coordinate close divided by prior-60-session coordinate high minus one

failed_breakdown_20.mechanism: downside level penetration followed by same-session recovery
failed_breakdown_20.score: penetration below prior-20 low plus closing recovery above that low
failed_breakdown_20.event_filter: coordinate low < prior-20 low and coordinate close > prior-20 low

demand_volume_shock.mechanism: positive price response confirmed by unusual activity
demand_volume_shock.score: one-session action-coordinate return multiplied by ln(volume/prior-20 mean volume)
demand_volume_shock.event_filter: one-session return > 0 and volume > prior-20 mean volume

compression_breakout.mechanism: range compression followed by objective expansion
compression_breakout.score: negative prior-20 coordinate range plus close clearance over prior-20 high
compression_breakout.event_filter: prior-20 range cross-sectional percentile <= 0.20 and coordinate close > prior-20 high

industry_rotation_20.event_filter: known valid PIT industry with at least five other eligible constituents

promotion.ranking_key: minimum early/late natural-horizon net mean excess versus date control, then full excess

executable_translation.same_open_order: apply visible actions, then eligible exits, then next-open entries
executable_translation.entry: next market open only; blocked or invalid names are skipped and cohort capital is redistributed across executable names
executable_translation.exit: first sell-executable open after natural holding close; blocked exits wait without lookahead
executable_translation.position_model: cohort and symbol lots remain separate; no leverage and no shorting

prohibited: no threshold, horizon, family, bundle, or cost search after outcomes
no CHINEXT RS-veto or minute-volatility-overlay tuning, validation, or combination
no strict PIT-A, OOS, validation, live, or causal-mechanism claim
no promotion of a family that misses any frozen gate
